Shipping your car, from planning to handover

Start with both ZIP codes, your vehicle details, pickup availability and running condition. The team can then confirm carrier options and pricing.

Read the guide

An interstate move starts with a good inventory

List your boxes, furniture and large items, then share access conditions and dates for both addresses. Confirm packing, loading, transport and assembly separately.

Read the guide

Storage between one home and the next

Identify what you need to store, where and for how long. Share your next delivery date and ask the team to confirm available arrangements.

Read the guide

Before you move: ship your car or sell it?

Compare shipping costs, your car’s condition, future needs and replacement options. Then discuss buying, selling and handover assistance with the team.

Read the guide

Open or enclosed: choosing how your car travels

The main difference is whether the vehicle travels in a covered trailer. Consider condition, dimensions, budget and protection needs, then confirm carrier requirements.

Read the guide

Understanding a moving or auto transport quote

A useful quote needs the route, dates and complete vehicle or inventory details. Historical article prices are not current offers.

Read the guide

Luggage in your car: what to confirm first

Before booking, explain the item types, total weight and placement. The team and carrier need to confirm acceptance and any additional charges.

Read the guide

Graduating and moving for a new job: a checklist

Put lease dates, work start dates and delivery availability into one plan. Then coordinate your car, belongings and any temporary storage.

Read the guide
